products.title: Twin Peacock Enamel Silver Purse
products.shortDescription: A 92.5% silver purse with facing blue-and-green enamel peacocks, gold-tone floral details, clear stone borders and a braided handle. Weight: 660 g.

images.alt: Silver purse with two blue-and-green enamel peacocks, clear stone borders, a teardrop clasp and braided handle.

products.title: Om Ganesha Silver Singhasan with Elephant Base
products.shortDescription: A 92.5% silver singhasan with a gold-tone Om back panel, Ganesha crest, three finials, ornate columns, floral scrollwork and an elephant-supported stepped base. Weight: 5,616 g.

images.alt: Ornate silver singhasan with gold-tone Om panel, Ganesha crest, three pointed finials, carved columns and elephant base.
